name: Akiota (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Akiota town emblem in green and pink: a green stylised figure crossed by a pink elliptical stroke.
history: Municipal flag of Akiota, a town in Hiroshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 October 2004.

features.role: Akiota town emblem — a green stylised figure crossed by a pink elliptical stroke
